summary.en-US: One click (or Alt+Shift+U) reopens the article you're reading on unwall.app, right in the same tab. No tracking, no data collection, and it only reads the URL of the tab you click it on.

version.approval_notes: No build step, minifier or bundler. The submitted files are the source. One background script (background.js) listens for browser.action.onClicked, rewrites the tab URL from https://host/path to https://unwall.app/host/path and calls browser.tabs.update on the same tab. Only permission: activeTab. No remote code, no data collection. To test: open any https article, then click the toolbar button or press Alt+Shift+U.
